name: turbopuffer
description: Gives search and RAG backends a serverless vector and BM25 full-text search database built on object storage, queried over an HTTP API or official SDKs.

skills.name: Vector Search
skills.description: Runs approximate nearest neighbor queries over dense or sparse vectors, combined with attribute filters on an inverted index.

skills.name: BM25 Full-Text Search
skills.description: Ranks documents with BM25 full-text search, with ranking and boosting, and supports fast trigram regex queries.

skills.name: Hybrid Search
skills.description: Combines vector and BM25 results with server-side reciprocal rank fusion to narrow large candidate sets before re-ranking.

skills.name: Namespace Branching
skills.description: Creates instant copy-on-write clones of a namespace with branch_from, with fully independent reads and writes afterward.
